definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese room with tatami mat flooring, used for entertaining guests or formal occasions.

examples.japanese: {座敷|ざしき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{客|きゃく}さま→お客様：08780_okyakusama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{迎|むか}えした→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: We welcomed the guests in the tatami room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{座敷|ざしき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{夕食|ゆうしょく}→夕食：03006_yuushoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: We ate dinner in the tatami room at the ryokan.

examples.japanese: {座敷|ざしき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧⟦とき→時：03094_toki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{脱|ぬ}いで→脱ぐ：00518_nugu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please take off your shoes when entering the tatami room.

notes:
{座敷|ざしき} is a traditional Japanese room with tatami flooring, typically used for formal occasions or entertaining guests.

Common collocations:
- {座敷|ざしき}に{上|あ}がる (to enter the tatami room)
- {座敷|ざしき}{席|せき} (tatami seating in a restaurant)
- お{座敷|ざしき} (polite form; also refers to geisha entertainment)
- {座敷|ざしき}{童|わらし} (a legendary child spirit said to bring good fortune)

Related words:
- {和室|わしつ} (Japanese-style room)
- {畳|たたみ} (tatami mat)
- {床|とこ}の{間|ま} (tokonoma - decorative alcove in a tatami room)
